notes: Lumang Palengke: the Lv 21-40 map west of the Slums (the Slums' west gate past the golem pit leads here, arrive.slums). Sections ring the central Market Hall; the entrance plaza (safeZone) is on the east. Levels run clockwise: Tarp Row 21, Gulayan 23, Tuyo't Tindahan 25-27, Karinderya Row 29, Karnehan 31, Isdaan 33, Market Hall 35 and the Great Scale 37. Objects sit with their manifest anchor on the top corner of tile (col,row). Hall walls are tile-edge pieces: back walls (north, west) are placed on the tile just outside the hall so one anchor works for both sides; front walls (south, east) on the wall tile itself; the east wall carries the front block with the clock tower. String lights have a litId: swap the sprite per player once that section's story reward is earned. Stalls (21 Oct 2026): each block of 2 x 2 stalls is drawn with as few pieces as fit (4 x 4 big stalls, 2 x 6 triples, 2 x 4 doubles, 2 x 2 singles), each look in three colours (-v2, -v3); a mirrored piece has flip: true and its footprint swapped. The blocked tiles are as before.
